title: System Size Validation
content: Solar system size must be a positive number measured in kilowatts. Zero, negative, or missing system sizes require correction before approval.

title: Required Sales Information
content: Sales records must contain the required customer, location, system, payment, and transaction information. Missing mandatory fields must be reviewed.

title: Australian State Validation
content: Sales records must use recognized Australian state or territory abbreviations: NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, or NT.

title: Roof Type Validation
content: Supported roof types in this demonstration are tile, metal, and concrete. Unsupported roof types require review.

title: Cash Deposit Requirement
content: For this fictional demonstration, cash purchases require a deposit of at least 5 percent of the total sale price. Deposits below this threshold fail quality control.

title: Signature Date Validation
content: The signature date must not occur after the recorded sale date. Inconsistent dates require correction.

title: Installation Scheduling
content: For this fictional demonstration, the requested installation date must be at least seven calendar days after the sale date.

title: Required Sold-Stage Documents
content: Deals in the Sold stage must have a switchboard photograph and an electricity bill recorded as received.

title: Postcode and State Consistency
content: The recorded postcode should be consistent with the Australian state or territory. The current demonstration uses simplified postcode validation and may require manual review for unsupported or ambiguous cases.

title: Unresolved Sales Red Flags
content: Unresolved customer cancellation requests, asbestos concerns, installation access restrictions, or customer disputes must be flagged for review. Historical issues that have been clearly resolved should not automatically fail.

title: Sales Record Contradictions
content: Written sales notes must be consistent with structured deal fields. Explicit contradictions, such as notes stating a metal roof when the recorded roof type is tile, must be flagged.
